description: Finds the parcels that contain a latitude and longitude. Costs 1 credit per request, however many parcels come back. Up to 1,000 parcels per request. Needs an API key. Lookups in counties we do not cover and failed requests cost no credits. Returns parcel records with WKT boundaries in EPSG:4326, owner, address, assessed values, land use and zoning where the county publishes them.
